afterContent.description: Content rendered inside the bubble after the message parts. Useful for placing inline metadata (e.g. timestamp, status) inside the bubble.

partProps.description: Props forwarded to the built-in unstyled part renderer components. Use this to pass slots and slotProps to individual part type renderers.

resolveBuiltInPartRenderer.description: Callback to resolve a built-in part renderer for a given part type.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

slotDescriptions.bubble: The component that renders the bubble.
slotDescriptions.content: The component that renders the content.
